messages.subject: Re: Dummy variables
parts:
I wonder if this has something to do with low cell frequencies:
> table(hoy$hosp3y,hoy$primarios)
      0   1
  0 146  28
  1  26   0
> table(hoy$hosp3y,hoy$masqueprim)
      0   1
  0 134  40
  1  23   3

Near-zero frequencies are common, and the hosp3y / primarios crosstab has a 0 count cell.
On Thu, Nov 17, 2022 at 9:19 AM Ángel Rodríguez Laso <angel...@gmail.com> wrote:

original database (1032 observations), the identification problems
disappear.

Ángel
